**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **Clause:** § 2.2 (first of the two provisions numbered 2.2, ¶p0013) — "Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term."
- **Why it fails:** Full-term exclusive dealing binding us, with no product-category limitation, no 12-month cap and no performance-based exit — walk-away territory under the rule, not merely short of preferred. It also conflicts with § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no exclusivity commitment.
- **Redline (validated ok:true, preferred level):** makes Vendor a non-exclusive provider and expressly preserves our right to procure the same or similar services from third parties; the narrowed 12-month, category-limited exclusivity with automatic termination on SLA/delivery failure is offered as a fallback in the comment.
- Note: the § 2.1 take-or-pay minimum-volume commitment is a separate commercial issue and is left to its own rule rather than double-flagged here.
